prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless hand-painted albedo texture for walkable mineralized organic crust in a hybrid pixel-character and 3D environment game. Create a square 1536x1536 edge-to-edge FLAT TOP-DOWN MATERIAL TEXTURE with no perspective, objects, borders, text, light source or shadows.
Surface is dry pale warm-grey mineral shell, subtly layered along diagonal direction, worn broad irregular interlocking plates with only sparse shallow broken seams. Quiet gouache painted colour masses and angular deliberate short brush clusters. At least 70 percent of image is restful flat medium-value mineral fields; middle-size directional scuffs and worn patches, a few small muted ivory deposits. Palette stone grey/taupe, cooler dusty slate grey joints, tiny subdued chalk highlights. Very low chroma, never saturated brown or green. Resolved sharp clean medium-scale painterly marks rather than photorealistic noise, sand, pores, busy cracks or grunge. Three or four close values only. No outlines around every slab, no regular masonry tiles, no large black fissures, no bevel/ambient occlusion on every seam, no photographic embossed surface. No fog, blur, cast shadows or baked directional illumination. Flat albedo designed to combine with gentle live lighting; all four edges should tile continuously with no obvious repeated emblem.
processing: Original tool output copied without raster editing. Runtime texture filtering and material rendering only.
runtime: Shared terrain/cliff/rock albedo at authored world UV scale; nearest magnification/trilinear minification; restrained material luminance/light steps. Source has directional pattern repetition; actual whole-scene review required.
